2610.09146.title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
2610.09146.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are usually frozen after deployment, so they do not learn from the cases they solve. This is especially concerning in medicine, where new clinical evidence, updated guidelines, and new therapies can change established practice. Fine-tuning can update the model, but it requires access to model weights and additional training. Parameter-free methods avoid training, but they may overfit a fixed validation set, lack reliable domain knowledge, or lose visual details by saving experience only as text. To address these limitations, we present a model-agnostic framework that allows frozen LLMs and VLMs to learn from deployment experience through three forms of external expertise: a Skill that guides reasoning and tool use, a Knowledge Memory that stores reliable facts supported by earlier cases or trusted external evidence, and a Multimodal Knowledge Base that keeps visual examples and guides the model to relate each retrieved case to the current image. Instead of relying on a fixed validation set, a validation strategy keeps an update only if it helps on new cases without degrading performance on earlier ones. Across six benchmarks covering clinical diagnosis, clinical workflows, medical reasoning, and medical and non-medical visual reasoning, and with four open-weight and closed-source base models, our framework improves performance during online deployment by up to 34.2% over the base model on medical tasks, generalizes to unseen cases, transfers to other models without further optimization, and works in non-medical domains.
2610.09146.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）和視覺語言模型（VLMs）在部署後通常是凍結的，因此它們不會從解決的案例中學習。這在醫學領域尤其令人擔憂，因為新的臨床證據、更新的指導方針和新療法可能會改變既定的實踐。微調可以更新模型，但需要訪問模型權重和額外的訓練。無參數的方法避免訓練，但可能會對固定的驗證集過擬合，缺乏可靠的領域知識，或僅通過將經驗保存為文本而失去視覺細節。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一個模型無關的框架，允許凍結的LLMs和VLMs通過三種形式的外部專業知識從部署經驗中學習：一個指導推理和工具使用的技能、一個存儲可靠事實的知識記憶，這些事實由早期案例或可信的外部證據支持，以及一個保持視覺範例的多模態知識庫，並引導模型將每個檢索到的案例與當前圖像相關聯。驗證策略不依賴於固定的驗證集，僅在對新案例有幫助而不降低早期案例性能的情況下進行更新。在涵蓋臨床診斷、臨床工作流程、醫學推理以及醫學和非醫學視覺推理的六個基準測試中，並且使用四個開放權重和封閉源代碼的基礎模型，我們的框架在醫學任務中在線部署期間將性能提高了最多34.2%，對未見案例具有良好的泛化能力，能夠轉移到其他模型而無需進一步優化，並且在非醫學領域中也能運作。
